content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers holding analogous posts or officers holding posts in the pay scale of Rs.20600-46500 (Rs. 10750-16750 pre-revised) with 3 years regular service in Major Port Trusts Experience: Deputation from officers of Major Port Trusts holding analogous posts or officers holding posts in the pay scale of Rs.20600-46500 (Rs. 10750-16750 pre-revised) with 3 years and in any case, not to exceed five years. Other conditions: Applicants must be clear from the vigilance angle, with no disciplinary or vigilance case pending or contemplated. The Head of Office must certify the applicant's integrity. The Head of Office must certify that no major or minor penalty was imposed during the last 10 years. Desirable: Preference will be given to the persons having experience in vigilance work.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation normally be for a period of three years and in any case, not to exceed five years.

content_sections.heading: How Will DPA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection by merit with benchmark in overall grading in APARs not below Very Good The selection will be by merit for which the benchmark in overall grading in the APARs will not be below Very Good

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested copies of ACRs of the applicants for the last five years Attested copies of all certificates No-objection Certificate of respective Ports An undertaking of the applicant, not to withdraw his/her candidature, if selected Vigilance/ Administrative Clearance from the concerned Ports in the Proforma prescribed by the Ministry (Annexure-III)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DPA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Forward applications in the prescribed format (Annexure-II) through proper channel. Include attested copies of ACRs for the last five years. Include attested copies of all certificates. Include No-objection Certificate of respective Ports. Include an undertaking not to withdraw candidature if selected. Include Vigilance/Administrative Clearance from the concerned Ports in Proforma prescribed by the Ministry (Annexure-III). Make sure it reaches by 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The applications received through proper channel only will be entertained. Applications received after the last date or without ACRs or otherwise incomplete will not be considered.
